title: Bootstrap default blue shipped as the brand primary

title: Unmodified Bootstrap theme layer shipped as the design system

No custom property, no radius identity, no tuned border tone. Section 14 component-library defaults: override border colour, radius, shadow and transition so the console does not read as the framework documentation site.

title: Cream ground, serif display and sage accent shipped together
evidence: All three legs of the combination are present: `background: #faf8f5` (cream, chroma above 0.008 at hue 60-100 with L > 0.94), `font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif` on body, and `.accent { color: #15573a }` / `.btn { background: #15573a }` sage-forest as the brand colour, with the `.shot` screenshot-card-on-the-right hero that ships with it. Any two of the three is the strong tell; this is three. Anchor colour and type to a real brand or reference rather than the current tasteful average.

title: Inter declared as the only sans face
evidence: `.btn { ... font-family: Inter, sans-serif; }` -- Inter is the single sans declared anywhere in the sheet, so it carries every non-serif surface. Inter is the training-corpus median and ships with shadcn. Use a face with personality (GT America, Soehne, ABC Diatype, Author, Switzer, IBM Plex Sans) or the platform system stack as a deliberate house voice, with explicit weights and tracking.

title: Emoji used as status dots, list bullets and button chrome
evidence: Seven emoji outside prose, all as interface chrome: `🟢` / `🟡` / `🔴` as the status dot in every table row (lines 37-39), `✅` and `⚠️` as list bullets in `ul.checks` (lines 43-45), and `🚀` inside the deploy button (line 47). title: No viewport meta tag in the document head
evidence: `<head>` (lines 3-24) declares `<meta charset>`, `<title>` and a `<style>` block and no `<meta name="viewport">`. Mobile browsers then lay the page out at a 980px assumed width and scale it down, so the 1200px shell below is rendered as a shrunken desktop screenshot. Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` -- without `user-scalable=no` or `maximum-scale=1`, which would be P4.

title: Fixed-pixel page shell that cannot resize
evidence: `.shell { width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px 40px; }` and `.lede { ... width: 640px; }` -- a `width`, not a `max-width`, so the shell overflows every viewport under 1280px and the lede never reflows. Size from the content and the container: `width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem)` on the shell and `max-inline-size: 58ch` on the lede.

title: Grid asserts a fixed column count at a fixed track width
evidence: `.lanes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px); gap: 40px; }` -- the column count is asserted rather than derived, so the three lanes stay 360px wide and overflow at any width below 1160px. Let the count fall out of the space: `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr)); gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);`.

title: Middle-dot meta strings on every lane row
evidence: Six spaced middle dots across three rows, the same `A · B · C` run each time: `1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted` (line 32), and the identical shape at lines 36 and 40. Three or more instances is the concentration threshold. Separate the meta fields with space and a vertical-rule token, or promote them to a `dl` with real labels (miles, rate, loads posted) so the numbers are readable as data rather than as chrome.

title: Flat-terminal subtraction-only system
evidence: Code-only read of the token map and markup. S3 depth fails: `--ground: oklch(0.12 0.003 270)` and `--panel: oklch(0.13 0.003 270)` are 0.01 L apart, one indistinguishable surface level, no rim and no elevation anywhere. S4 containment fails: `--hair: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08)` at 8% alpha is the only boundary on `.panel` and every table row. S1/S2 accent fails: `--accent: oklch(0.6 0.02 270)` is chroma 0.02, colour is reserved for `--ok`/`--bad` status only and absent from first paint. Type is `system-ui` at `font-weight: 400` throughout with no display face. That is S3 and S4 failing together with S1 and S2 on one surface -- the V13 signature. Remediation from the substance-floor pairing table, not another removal: derive the ground from the brand hue, raise `.panel` to a perceivable third level with a top-edge rim, take the boundary to a real `--edge` token that measures against both surfaces, and give the accent chroma 0.10+ with a fill role on first paint (the aria-current nav item, the panel values).

title: Frosted-glass sticky navigation bar, verbatim

Vary the nav height and drop the blur unless it is doing real work keeping type legible over moving content; a static header, a sidebar or a mega-menu are all valid, and the border-bottom alone already separates it from the page.

title: Saturated neon glow on the CTA

title: Focus outline removed with no :focus-visible replacement

title: Purple-to-fuchsia-to-blue default gradient on the hero

title: No real imagery on a camera product page

title: Fixed-pixel app shell that cannot resize
evidence: `.app-shell { width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; ... }` -- a `width`, not a `max-width`, so the console overflows horizontally at every viewport under 1180px and wastes the space above it. `width: min(100% - 2rem, 74rem)` sizes from the space available and keeps a gutter at narrow widths with no media query.

title: Grid asserts four fixed pixel column tracks
evidence: `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 260px);` on `.app-shell` -- the four panels are pinned at 260px whatever the shell is given, so the layout breaks at every width the author did not picture. `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));` lets the column count fall out of the available space.

title: 100vh full-height shell on a mobile-reachable surface
evidence: `.app-shell { ... height: 100vh; }` -- `vh` resolves against the largest possible viewport, so with mobile browser chrome visible the last 60-100px of the console sits under the toolbar. title: Literal radius values repeated with no radius identity stated
evidence: Three raw radius literals and no token anywhere in the file: `.panel { border-radius: 6px; }` (line 14), `.panel__header { border-radius: 6px; }` (line 19), `.pill { border-radius: 12px; }` (line 24). Nothing states what the radius means, so the 12px on the pill reads as an accident rather than a second step. Declare `--radius: 6px` and derive: `border-radius: var(--radius)` on panels, `calc(var(--radius) * 2)` on pills, and commit the value to a POV (0 or 2px tactical, 12px soft).

title: Indigo-to-violet default gradient on the primary CTA

evidence: `.accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; -webkit-background-clip: text; color: transparent; }` applied at line 28 to the single word `reconciled` inside the `h1`. title: shadcn init token block shipped untouched
evidence: The `:root` block (lines 9-19) is the current Tailwind-v4 `shadcn init` scaffold verbatim: `--radius: 0.625rem`, `--background: oklch(1 0 0)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)`, `--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)`, `--primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0)`, `--border`/`--input: oklch(0.922 0 0)`, `--ring: oklch(0.708 0 0)`. title: Save button bypasses the token scale defined above it

title: One 8px radius on every control with no radius identity stated
evidence: `border-radius: 8px` on all three control rules and therefore on every interactive element of the form: `input, select, textarea` (line 21), `.chip` (line 25), `button.submit` (line 27) -- five-plus controls, one value, and no `--radius` token in a `:root` that names `--ink`, `--paper`, `--rule` and `--moss`. 8px is the pre-v4 shadcn default; nothing here chose it. title: rounded-full on every control with no radius identity stated
evidence: The same maximal radius on five interactive controls and no radius token anywhere: text input (line 40), select (line 45), textarea (line 53), the inline chip span (line 57) and the submit button (line 60), all `rounded-full`. title: 100vh app shell on a mobile driver surface
evidence: `.app { height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }` -- `vh` resolves against the largest viewport, so with mobile browser chrome visible the bottom 60-100px of the run list sits under the toolbar. title: Bottom-pinned action bar ignores the safe-area inset
evidence: `.bar { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; ... padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }` -- Skip stop and Mark delivered are pinned to the bottom edge with a flat 0.75rem of bottom padding, so on a device with a home indicator or gesture bar the primary actions of a delivery run sit under it. `padding-bottom: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));` with `viewport-fit=cover` in the viewport meta. title: Firing card laid out by a viewport query in two different columns
evidence: `@media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; ... } }` (lines 30-33) restyles a component, not the page shell, and `.firing` appears in both the `aside.rail` (line 40, sized `flex: 0 0 clamp(14rem, 20vw, 18rem)`) and the `section.main` (lines 46, 50). Give the host the container and query it: `.rail, .main { container-type: inline-size; }` then `@container (min-width: 28rem) { .firing { grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } }`, so each card responds to the space it was actually given.

title: Monospace family on the human-readable readouts (level value, preset buttons, point totals, rank badge, numeric table cells) where tabular-nums already aligns the digits
evidence: Blind single-fixture dispatch 2026-09-22 (0.6.2, after the 40-fixture run): scanner pre-pass mono-on-ui-text at line 13, six font-family:var(--font-mono) declarations on readouts each beside font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; the textarea (line 25) and input[readonly] (line 27) are raw payloads and exempt.
